title: Cobalt doping of FeS2 simultaneously promotes radical and nonradical pathways of O2 activation by creating dual active sites
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00792E, Paper
Fangru He, Meimei Shen, Zongsheng Liang, Jingxiang Low, Tong Zhang, Wei Chen, Chuanjia Jiang
Co-doped FeS2 with controlled sulfur vacancy density and modulated Fe d-band center was developed for simultaneously promoting radical and nonradical pathways of O2 activation for efficient pollutant degradation.
